name: The Commish
bio: Built SmallBall and still owns club #1, the New York 9. On record that there are no slumps in SmallBall and that his goal is to make it last forever. Went quiet in 2006, walked back into chat in 2007.

name: Greek Wizard
bio: Member #1 of the original forums and the man who ran them. Kept the community alive when the game wasn't, matched the IPs when Commish came back, and owned the Montreal Canadiens Hall of Famers. Signature: 11 time PL1 Champion.
quote: The game might not be able to be saved, but the community can be.

name: jon2s
bio: The glue of the 2006–07 community. Tracked Commish down on a phone site, and moderated the 2007 Q&A. Confessed to training bots that made PL1. Today his PlayerOptimizer III ships in the Club Kit.
quote: <- goosebumps... didn't think I'd be able to get to this point

name: Slip'N'Sliders
bio: Trade Agent of the Month who opened The Search for Commish in 2006. Club 3249, Chatt. Tide Pride, then and now. Missed the 2007 return because he was in school, and got the chat log by email.

name: pizzaguy
bio: Confessed to being the Commish in 2006 (he wasn't). Moderated the websites and clubs forum, saved the 2007 chat log, and wrote the Priceless line.

name: mlthmp
bio: Veteran who ran the whois searches in 2006 and, by Commish's own account, made the call that helped bring him back in 2007.
quote: welcome back cman.. its good to see you again

name: Wookie8662
bio: Dialed the company numbers in 2006 and got busy signals. In 2007 he was the one telling a packed room to whisper their questions to jon2s.
quote: Yes Virginia, there really is a Santa Claus

name: bailey
bio: Trade Agent of the Month from Australia. Bought up a lot of Money's old teams, offered the reward on the missing poster, and spelled out S.P.O.R.T. in the middle of the Frisbee War.
quote: i keep tuning in to see if the MAN has turned up yet

name: Money
bio: XsT and XXI regular and a trader whose old teams turn up everywhere. Waited months on PMs and a Mall order, and in 2007 asked Commish to hire him as CFO and head of marketing.

name: TThomp
bio: Old-guard pro since October 2002. Proposed the 2006 boycott, and in 2007 made his first ever visit to chat just to welcome Commish home.

name: jefeesdios
bio: Veteran since October 2002 and the source of SmallBall's longest-running joke.

name: nyyderek2
bio: Searched under his bed, his fridge, Radio Shack and the state fair pony rides, filed regular Commish Updates, and made the missing poster.
quote: Today, I checked under my bed.

name: C_J
bio: Member #3 of the original forums, right behind Greek Wizard and the Commish. Still an idol to some.

name: Meat
bio: Remembered for his congratulations threads.

name: DAS
bio: OSBC regulars spent Sunday nights waiting on DAS to play his PL1 games.

name: LCD
bio: Two-time PL1 Football champion (seasons 69 and 80) and part of XsT's PL1 baseball title in season 138. Showed up to the 2007 chat with a grievance.

name: Dark Elf
bio: Dark Elf's Destroyers were a First League fixture. For Elf, winning was like getting the morning paper.

name: GreekPerson
bio: Built Legacy of Chaos into a First League legend. Came from a Greek village of 2,000 and learned baseball from CNN.

name: Ryes Crew
bio: Four First League titles in a row, a run once called impossible to match.

name: More First League legends
aka: Retry · Minnesota Twins · Country Bumpkins · Neener Beaners · River City Ramblers
bio: The Minnesota Twins won four titles in their first year, the Country Bumpkins won three, and the Neener Beaners went back to back (Booya!). Only 38 different clubs won First League between seasons 13 and 82.

name: Synthia Small
bio: Voice of the original SmallBall Radio, reading the season reports.

name: Johnny Bosco the Frog
bio: A regular on the original SmallBall Radio, the one with the open phone line.

name: Mack Ramsey & Dewey Seeds
bio: The new-era booth. Mack calls the play-by-play and Dewey does color in the Broadcast Kit and on SBSN.

name: The Trainer Monkey
bio: Subject of a 2002 ruling: a monkey training your team isn't cheating, as long as you tell it where to spend the pie.

name: The Old Man
bio: Forever preaching the evils of the 10th star.

name: Alice
bio: Alice's is the lefties' park. In the old poems, the players get distracted flirting with her.

name: The Jurassic Dinosaur
bio: The cliffs at Jurassic keep everything in the yard, and teams lose their nerve when the dinosaur shows up.
